# gadgetplots

**Plot gadget3 model output using ggplot2. R package version 0.3.8**

The gadgetplots package produces diagnostics graphics for
[gadget3](https://github.com/gadget-framework/gadget3) using
[ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference). The package replaces
the plotting capabilities of
[Rgadget](https://github.com/gadget-framework/rgadget) package which was
designed to work with
[gadget2](https://github.com/gadget-framework/gadget2).

## Installation

The gadgetplots is not available on CRAN yet. Use the devtools or
remotes packages to install directly from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("gadget-framework/gadgetplots")
```

## Usage

See the [**function
reference**](https://gadget-framework.github.io/gadgetplots/reference/index.html)
for a detailed list of functions and documentation on how to use them.

The
[`make_html()`](https://gadget-framework.github.io/gadgetplots/reference/make_html.html)
function generates a [single html
file](https://gadget-framework.github.io/gadgetplots/articles/make_html_output.html)
out of
[`gadgetutils::g3_fit()`](https://rdrr.io/github/gadget-framework/gadgetutils/man/g3_fit.html)
output that contains key model diagnostics. Further, the package
produces plots in four categories:

1.  `plot_*()` functions plot gadget model **output** generated using
    [`gadgetutils::g3_fit()`](https://rdrr.io/github/gadget-framework/gadgetutils/man/g3_fit.html).
    These functions have a generic shorthand, the
    [`plot()`](https://gadget-framework.github.io/gadgetplots/reference/plot.gadget.fit.html),
    with `param` argument specifying the type of plot.

2.  `dplot_*()` functions plot gadget model **input data** generated
    using [mfdb](https://github.com/gadget-framework/mfdb),
    [`gadgetutils::g3_data()`](https://rdrr.io/github/gadget-framework/gadgetutils/man/g3_data.html)
    or
    [`gadgetutils::add_g3_attributes()`](https://rdrr.io/github/gadget-framework/gadgetutils/man/add_g3_attributes.html)
    functions.

3.  the [`g3d_plot()`](reference/g3d_plot.md) function plots **data
    directly** from a gadget model object.

4.  `g3plot_*` functions plot gadget **suitability (selectivity)
    functions**.

## Found a bug or desire a feature?

The package is under an active development together with gadget3
framework. Please report bugs and write feature requests under
[Issues](https://github.com/gadget-framework/gadgetplots/issues).

# Package index

## Model overviews

The [`make_html()`](../reference/make_html.md) function generates a
[single html
file](https://gadget-framework.github.io/gadgetplots/articles/make_html_output.html)
out of
[`gadgetutils::g3_fit()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/gadgetutils/man/g3_fit.html)
output that contains key model diagnostics. The
[`gadget_plots()`](../reference/gadget_plots.md) function saves a set of
diagnostics plots into a folder.

- [`make_html()`](make_html.md) : Save diagnostic graphs to a single
  html document
- [`gadget_plots()`](gadget_plots.md) : Wrapper for plot.gadget.fit that
  saves all diagnostic graphs to a directory

## Plotting functions

The package produces plots in four categories:

1.  `plot_*()` functions plot gadget model **output** generated using
    [`gadgetutils::g3_fit()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/gadgetutils/man/g3_fit.html).
    These functions have a generic shorthand, the
    [`plot()`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html), with
    `param` argument specifying the type of plot.

2.  `dplot_*()` functions plot gadget model **input data** generated
    using [mfdb](https://github.com/gadget-framework/mfdb),
    [`gadgetutils::g3_data()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/gadgetutils/man/g3_data.html)
    or
    [`gadgetutils::add_g3_attributes()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/gadgetutils/man/add_g3_attributes.html)
    functions.

3.  the [`g3d_plot()`](../reference/g3d_plot.md) function plots **data
    directly** from a gadget model object.

4.  `g3plot_*` functions plot gadget **suitability (selectivity)
    functions**.

## The `plot_*` for `g3_fit` output

These functions make the plots typically used in asssessment and model
diagnostics. Some of the functions have `return_data` argument, which
can be used to quickly grab associated data for further analyses, custom
plots and tables.

### General

- [`plot(`*`<gadget.fit>`*`)`](plot.gadget.fit.md) :

  Plot `gadget.fit` object

- [`plot_annual()`](plot_annual.md) : Plot annual ICES type of graphic
  returning central model data

### Age-related

- [`plot_adist()`](plot_adist.md) : Plot model age distributions for
  stocks by year
- [`plot_ageclass()`](plot_ageclass.md) : Plot an age class from the
  model
- [`plot_agecomp()`](plot_agecomp.md) : Plot of age composition from the
  model
- [`plot_agelength()`](plot_agelength.md) : Plot of fitted growth for
  each age-length component
- [`plot_growth()`](plot_growth.md) : Plot of average growth for each
  stock

### Stock status

- [`plot_biomass()`](plot_biomass.md) : Plot stock biomasses
- [`plot_ssb()`](plot_ssb.md) : Plot spawning stock biomass
- [`plot_rec()`](plot_rec.md) : Plot recruitment
- [`plot_sr()`](plot_sr.md) : Plot stock-recruitment relationship
- [`plot_si()`](plot_si.md) : Plot survey indices

### Catches and fleets

- [`plot_catch()`](plot_catch.md) : Plot catches
- [`plot_f()`](plot_f.md) : Plot fishing mortality
- [`plot_hr()`](plot_hr.md) : Plot harvest rate
- [`plot_suitability()`](plot_suitability.md) : Plot suitability

### Distributions

- [`plot_catchdist()`](plot_catchdist.md) : Plot catch distributions
- [`plot_ldist()`](plot_ldist.md) : Plot model length distributions for
  stocks by year
- [`plot_stockcomp()`](plot_stockcomp.md) : Plot model stock composition
- [`plot_stockdist()`](plot_stockdist.md) : Plot stock distribution

### Parameters and fit

- [`plot_likelihood()`](plot_likelihood.md) : Plot likelihood summary
- [`plot_param()`](plot_param.md) : Plot parameter values relative to
  their boundaries
- [`plot_resid()`](plot_resid.md) : Plot residuals for catch
  distributions
- [`plot_weight()`](plot_weight.md) : Plot parameter weights

### Model diagnostics

These functions require a list of gadget.fit objects generated using the
[`gadgetutils::g3_jitter()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/gadgetutils/man/g3_jitter.html),
[`gadgetutils::g3_leaveout()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/gadgetutils/man/g3_leaveout.html),
and
[`gadgetutils::g3_retro()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/gadgetutils/man/g3_retro.html)
functions.

- [`plot_jitter()`](plot_jitter.md) : Plot central model output from a
  jitter analysis
- [`plot_leaveout()`](plot_leaveout.md) : Plot central model output from
  a leave-out analysis
- [`plot_retro()`](plot_retro.md) : Plot model biomass from a
  retrospective analysis

## The `dplot_*` for gadget input data

These functions plot gadget input data attempting to highlight
attributes, which guide the model fitting, but are often difficult to
notice otherwise.

- [`dplot_adist()`](dplot_adist.md) : Plot age distribution data for a
  gadget3 model
- [`dplot_aldist()`](dplot_aldist.md) : Plot age-length distribution
  data for a gadget3 model
- [`dplot_ldist()`](dplot_ldist.md) : Plot length distribution data for
  a gadget3 model
- [`dplot_sexr()`](dplot_sexr.md) : Plot sex ratio data for a gadget3
  model
- [`dplot_stockdist()`](dplot_stockdist.md) : Plot stock distribution
  data for a gadget3 model
- [`dplot_catch()`](dplot_catch.md) : Plot catch data for a gadget3
  model

## The `g3d_plot` for gadget model objects

The [`g3d_plot()`](../reference/g3d_plot.md) function plots all
observational data passed into a TMB or R gadget model.

- [`g3d_plot()`](g3d_plot.md) : Plot of data passed into a gadget model

## The `g3plot_*` for suitability functions

These plot gadget suitability functions, which can be difficult to
comprehend without visualizing. The model parameters can be extracted
from a gadget.fit object or typed in manually.

- [`g3plot_andersen()`](g3plot_andersen.md) : Plot Andersen suitability
  using model parameters
- [`g3plot_exponentiall50()`](g3plot_exponentiall50.md) : Plot
  exponentiall50 suitability using model parameters

## Example data

Datasets to demonstrate plot functions.

- [`fit`](fit.md) : An example gadget.fit object.
- [`aldist_example`](aldist_example.md) : Age-length input data to
  gadget
- [`ldist_example`](ldist_example.md) : Length input data to gadget
- [`sexratio_example`](sexratio_example.md) : Sex input data to gadget
- [`stockdist_example`](stockdist_example.md) : Maturity input data to
  gadget
- [`TrawlNor_catches`](example_catches.md)
  [`Internat_catches`](example_catches.md)
  [`OtherNor_catches`](example_catches.md)
  [`OtherRus_catches`](example_catches.md)
  [`TrawlRus_catches`](example_catches.md) : Catch input data to gadget
